scope: g15 baseline characterization; no speedup or release qualification
timing_reference: actual interpolated CLK rising 50% VDD crossing
limitations: Selected SS read and write cycles; FF safety slacks reuse the completed original waveform scores; detector slacks are re-extracted.
64/128 arrays freeze unprobed cells as described in each run provenance.
Recorded timing table metadata may name schematic lookup; actual simulated periods are authoritative.
The tool does not independently repeat all historical retention/scorer checks.
